items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries of the same event both passing the Set check before either records it, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says the key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and replaying a valid signed body with a different header bypasses de-duplication.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes or replicas; gap 0 is in-process queue concurrency and gap 1 is a single-process crash.
